How hearing monitoring works

Each daily check reads official House and Senate meeting feeds and House, Senate, and joint-committee upcoming-meeting lists. It opens 90R notices and matches bill numbers against the bills on this tracker. Notices from earlier sessions are excluded.

Matched notices retain a change history. Explicit cancellation notices and bills removed from an agenda are labeled. A notice disappearing from an upcoming list is not treated as a cancellation. Previously matched notices remain available under “All notices & history.” Tracking begins when a notice is first detected; this is not a complete historical archive.

The watchlist filter uses the same bills saved in this browser. Monitoring does not send email or text alerts, and it does not establish testimony or filing deadlines. Committee notices are checked daily; chamber floor calendars, minutes, and witness lists are not separately ingested.
